title: Linux desktop client: native kith app for Linux
description:
A native desktop client for kith on Linux.

Scope:
- Connect to user's kithd over tailnet (tailscaled already running on Linux desktop)
- Contact list, chat list, message thread (1:1 and group)
- Send/receive messages; read receipts; attachment upload/download
- Desktop notifications via libnotify / org.freedesktop.Notifications
- System tray icon with unread count
- EventSource for live push
- File manager integration for attachment save/open
- Target: Tauri (Rust + WebView, ships as .deb/.rpm/AppImage) OR GTK4 + libadwaita for GNOME-native feel; decide in research phase
- Distribution: .deb, .rpm, Flatpak (Flathub), AppImage
